Container.Name: Nodal
Container.Overview: Nodal is a fast, GPU-accelerated 360° panorama viewer and virtual tour builder. Upload equirectangular panoramas from the browser; Nodal tiles them into multi-resolution cube pyramids and serves a WebGPU/WebGL viewer with hotspots, polygon areas, zoom-through transitions, little-planet, fisheye and Pannini projections, deep links, and a built-in tour editor. Set an access token to protect uploads and edits.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Tours (tiles, thumbnails, tour.json) and temporary uploads.

Config.Name: Access token
Config.Description: When set, uploading, editing and deleting tours require this token (enter it once in the web UI). Viewing stays public. Leave empty only on a trusted network.

Config.Name: Read-only
Config.Description: true = serve tours only; disables uploads, edits and deletes.

Config.Name: Tile JPEG quality
Config.Description: 1-100. Higher looks better and uses more space.
